qualifiedVerdicts.content: Blind facet-split reviews of the signed candidate ec1539c and serialized rechecks of the signed fix commit 9fb6ed8 found the original correctness, scoped-coverage, quiz-safety and comprehensibility defects resolved; cross-file consistency was clean throughout. 提出 now defines the noun as the act of submitting («подача, сдача чего-либо») rather than the submitted item, and quotes 出す with EN's contextual gloss «выносить; сдавать». 不利, 握手, 批評 and 批判 restore EN's hiragana reading joins (ふ + り, あく + しゅ, ひ + ひょう, ひ + はん). 指す's title and heading become «указывать на что-либо», dropping a finger restriction that the body withdraws and an «иметь в виду» sense that the card never teaches. 手品 drops an English-dependent aside about the dictionary gloss "juggling" while keeping its Russian contrast with жонглирование, and 抱く drops an author note about dictionary markup. 不利 renders EN "arrangement" as «условия». Quiz guards were added on 交換 (両替), 掴む (捕まえる, 理解) and 持ち上げる (立てる). Final verdicts: correctness CLEAN; scoped coverage CLEAN; comprehensibility CLEAN; consistency CLEAN; quiz safety CLEAN within reviewed batch scope. Full initial reviewer reports, reconciliation, the preserved author/reviewer required-versus-conservative exclusion classification and process notes are attached. No native-speaker, app-import, device, learner, voice, drawing, runtime or ordinary-release acceptance is claimed.

qualifiedVerdicts.quizTitles: All 19 EN exclusions across 12 lists are retained. The reviewed RU title overlaps received 6 direct, one-sided exclusions on 4 new cards: 交換–代わり/両替; 扱う–操作; 掴む–捕まえる/理解; 持ち上げる–立てる. The author added 交換–代わり and 扱う–操作 and classed both as conservative; it declined 抜ける–降る because their qualifiers on «выпадать» are disjoint. The other four were added after review from the consistency reviewer's findings F1-F3: 掴む–捕まえる and 持ち上げる–立てる as required-class, and 交換–両替 and 掴む–理解 as conservative, because the EN titles of 交換 and 両替 share "exchange" equally without a guard and 理解 is a verb/noun-sense collision. The consistency reviewer called 扱う–操作 required and 交換–代わり conservative, found no pair unjustified, and on recheck accepted the reassessment of 交換–両替. These differences are preserved, not voted. Android applies each declaration symmetrically, so no reverse declarations were added to baseline cards.

titleDecisions.declinedOptional: Declined optional items: the consistency reviewer's conservative guards 掲示→放送 («объявление») and 手術→作業 («операция»), because both titles are qualified and the reviewer rated them nonblocking; the comprehensibility reviewer's note that 持ち上げる's title leads with «приподнимать» while the body says «поднимать» (the title renders EN "lift up; flatter", and the 立てる overlap is now guarded); and its title-screen leads 抜ける/降る and 手術/作業 (disjoint qualifiers; 手術 is limited to surgery). The optional 不利 «условия» wording was adopted. No reviewer finding remains open.
